name: Arrivals | Electric baggage buggy
description: A loaded electric baggage buggy parked alongside the porter's lodge. The driving cab is open on both sides.

name: Pool Club | Teak loungers
description: Four nested teak loungers on a wheeled rack. A guest has unfolded the fifth beside the water and left a striped towel over the edge.

name: Terrace Restaurant | Banquet-table dolly
description: Four circular folding tables on a steel dolly outside the restaurant service entrance. A webbing strap secures the stack.

name: North Guest Villa | Housekeeping cart
description: A housekeeping cart beside the guest entrance, stocked with fresh linen and pump bottles. A canvas laundry sack hangs from its side.
